title: YouTuber detained in Gurugram ahead of CJP protest against CEC
seoTitle: Gurugram YouTuber detained ahead of CJP protest

tea.why: Protesters and a detained YouTuber object to alleged irregularities in voter rolls and internal disputes within the Election Commission.
tea.want: Addressing alleged irregularities in voter rolls and protesting against the Chief Election Commissioner.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Gurugram Police and Delhi Police detained YouTuber Dhruv Rathee ahead of the CJP protests against the CEC.

summary: On October 10, 2026, YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by Gurugram and Delhi police from his residence in Gurugram ahead of a planned protest led by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The demonstrations were organized over alleged irregularities in voter rolls, following media reports detailing internal objections raised by election commissioners regarding electoral database management. Ahead of the protests, authorities placed the national capital on high alert, deployed central forces, suspended internet services, and erected barricades. The Election Commission disputed interpretations of the report, stating that all decisions were unanimous and part of internal deliberative processes.
demands: Address alleged irregularities in voter rolls
response: Gurugram Police and Delhi Police detained YouTuber Dhruv Rathee ahead of the demonstrations. Authorities placed the national capital on high alert, deployed central forces, suspended internet services, and erected barricades.
